name: BDD: Check company address
summary:
User Story:  GWA-20696, GWA-20858, GWA-20909

Tier(/s): Office

Brand: UK

Account type(/s): Admin
preconditions:
Entry points: 

    1. Create a new unconfirmed account
    2. Open activation link 
    3. Go to the Company address page

    Notes:

    • Fill all fields with valid values, except current
    • To check all strings change the language to en_us if possible

steps.name: Observe the page
steps.expectedResult:
Text - Business Information Verification

Text - Company address

Fields:

  • Company registered number
  • Official company name
  • Trading name(DBA)

Button - Add more Trading names

Fields:

  • Official company address (Listed in the Company House Register) - link with value https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/
  • Road/Street
  • City
  • Post code
  • County
  • Country - United Kingdom (disabled)

Button - Save and continue (disabled)

steps.name:
Check fields validation:

  1. Check "Company registered number" with more than 64 symbols
  2. Check "Official company name" with more than 64 symbols
  3. Check "Trading name (DBA)" with more than 64 symbols
  4. Check "Official company address (Listed in the Company House Register)" with more than 64 symbols

Check trading name functionality

  1. Add plus one trading name
  2. Click button Remove
steps.expectedResult:
1. The new field has been added with the label  "Trading name", and also appears button "Remove"
  2. Field is deleted

steps.name: Fill all fields with valid data and clcik button "Save and continue" is enabled
